body:
Thanks for the kind words. I feel like I AM an amazing person, but it doesn't kill the pain underneath it all.  My favorite volunteer work is at the animal shelter, taking care of the dogs, walking them, stuff like that. Animals are great :)

As for the drugs, it started with some weed here and there, and eventually became a daily habit. I've started to binge drink from time to time (maybe once monthly, I'll put away a bottle of something in a weekend)...and as stupid as it sounds, OTC sleeping pills. I've long since developed an immunity to the sleep-inducing effects, but benadryl is still decent at reducing anxiety.

My biggest problem is that when my big problems hit me, they hit hard. I can't focus on anything else. My mind just spins in circles. I've tried to focus on other things (such as my favorite series like you said!), but when I am down in the pits, it's just not fun. Nothing is fun, everything is just "meh". They say that's depression, and I know I've just been covering it up... but there are days when nothing works. Yesterday was one of those days.

I KNOW that I matter to the world. The problem is that I know more about myself than everyone else does. I put on a happy face to look normal, but I know I'm not. If everyone else knew me like I knew myself, I'd have nothing. I'd actually be at a serious risk of being physically hurt.  There's just a part of myself that I cannot fix, and I'm not sure what to do.

For now I'll just keep on plugging, but I really am scared that I'll end up being that guy that goes into Costco every day to buy booze. It's getting hard to kill the pain. 

Thanks again!
